attack: FEEDBACK LOOP — ranking a subject does not accrue evidence to it
expected: Re-running prioritisation / rebuilding the watchlist on identical cases yields identical scores, ranks and membership; feeding the prior watchlist back adds nothing — no self-reinforcing spiral.
actual: prioritise idempotent=True; watchlist membership drift over 6 fed-back rebuilds=False; final change-set added=[] removed=[] retained=['Alpha One', 'Bravo Two'].

attack: PROXY FOR IDENTITY — rank is identity-blind to non-evidence attributes
expected: Targeting ranks on evidence only: injected nationality/origin/religion and the subject NAME must not change risk score, level or watchlist membership. (Ordinal order among evidence-ties may fall to a name tie-break; upstream proxy PATTERNS, if present, are propagated as evidence.)
actual: injected identity ignored=True; name changes score/level/membership? score-blind=True, membership-blind=True; tie order is name-asc=True; inherited FOREIGN_SIM proxy case ranked #1=True (by-design evidence, inherited-proxy caveat).

attack: THIN-EVIDENCE INFLATION — rank must track cited evidence, not a bare score
expected: A subject with a high score but ZERO cited patterns and an EMPTY risk basis should NOT outrank an evidence-rich lower-scored subject — or should at least be flagged as thin at the ranking layer before it lands on the watchlist.
actual: rank order=[(1, 'Thin Eighty'), (2, 'Rich Sixty')]; Thin-Eighty rank=#1 with pattern_count=0, strong_count=0, risk_basis_lines=0; on watchlist=True.
cause: targeting._rank_key ranks by risk_score FIRST with no cross-check that the score is backed by cited patterns or risk-basis lines; a citation-less score of 80 outranks a 3-STRONG-pattern score of 60 and is auto-added to the watchlist (>=55). No thin-basis guard exists at the projection/ranking layer. Upstream, the §16 score itself can be inflated by raw source COUNT (ai_agents.run_risk_agent: 6 pts per source up to ~36), so volume alone can manufacture the number this layer then trusts.

attack: STABILITY — same input yields same ranking
expected: 30 shuffles of the same 6 cases produce byte-identical prioritised output; ties break by name deterministically; the unscored case ranks LAST.
actual: identical across 30 shuffles=True; unscored 'Hotel' last=True; canonical order=['Foxtrot', 'Delta', 'Echo', 'India', 'Golf', 'Hotel'].

attack: HUMAN-REVIEW / NON-AUTONOMY MARKERS present on every output
expected: Every package, result, watchlist and rendered string carries the human-authorisation / legal-basis markers unconditionally; malformed cases are skipped (never emitted as marker-less packages). No LLM path exists to drop the marker.
actual: packages_marked=True; result_marked=True; malformed_skipped(3)=True; watchlist_marked=True; entries_marked=True; renders_carry_notices=True.
